title: AMERICA SAID NO
description: America said no. So I found another way.

panel-001.alt: Cover artwork for AMERICA SAID NO.

panel-002.alt: HOGIRL imagines studying in an American culinary classroom.

panel-003.alt: HOGIRL holds a book and focuses on her goal.

captions.text:
I knew where I wanted to go
and what I wanted to learn.

panel-004.alt: HOGIRL prepares to study in America.

captions.text:
I started preparing
to study in America.

Then came
the final hurdle,
the visa interview.

panel-006.alt: A dark background for the visa rejection.

captions.text:
You think I’d give up
just because one door closed?

panel-009.alt: HOGIRL renews her resolve beside the Han River in four panels.

captions.text:
I’ll come back
with an acceptance letter.

panel-010.alt: HOGIRL opens her research materials again.

captions.text:
How else
could I get there…?

Then I opened
everything up again.

panel-011.alt: Belgian and Swiss landmarks and chocolate-making scenes.

panel-012.alt: HOGIRL discovers countries known for chocolate.

captions.text:
One by one,
the countries famous for chocolate
began to appear.

panel-013.alt: HOGIRL reconsiders her choice of America.

captions.text:
Why does it
have to be America?

panel-014.alt: HOGIRL considers Europe on a map.

captions.text:
I looked at the map again.
And suddenly, the answer was obvious.

A long history.
Le Cordon Bleu.

panel-016.alt: HOGIRL imagines Paris with bright anticipation.

captions.text:
Even when I fall,
I’ll find the pearl.

panel-020.alt: HOGIRL prepares an eight-slide presentation to persuade her family.

captions.text:
There was only
one thing left to do.
